headline: Hezbollah Claims Missile-Drone Strikes on Saudi Forces in Yemen Amid Regional Tensions
subheadline: Hezbollah claimed missile and drone attacks on Saudi positions in Mocha, Yemen, as a Houthi strike ignited a fire at an Aramco facility in Jazan.
lede: Hezbollah claimed responsibility for missile and drone attacks on Saudi military positions in Mocha, Yemen, while a Houthi strike caused a fire at an Aramco facility in Jazan with no casualties. The IDF destroyed a cross-border tunnel and seized weapons near Aitaroun in northern Galilee, and Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei met President Pezeshkian to discuss economic and military developments amid the U.S.-Israeli war. In Ukraine, Russian forces launched ballistic missiles from Bryansk region, expanded mandatory evacuation in Kherson region to Krasnopilskе and Charivne, and struck Odesa, Kharkiv, and Zhytomyr overnight.

sections.title: Russian Missile Strikes Escalate Across Northern Ukraine
sections.body: Russian forces launched ballistic missiles from Bryansk region targeting northern Ukraine, while overnight strikes hit Odesa, Kharkiv, and Zhytomyr causing casualties and residential damage. Ukrainian authorities expanded mandatory evacuation to Krasnopilskе and Charivne in Kherson region due to constant shelling, and extensive Shahed drone activity was reported across eight-plus regions including Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, and Poltava. Russian troops advanced near Illinivka and Chasiv Yar in Donetsk per DeepState mapping, and the MoD claimed liberation of Vasyutinskoye and Toretskoye villages in DPR.

sections.title: IDF Destroys Tunnel Amid Hezbollah-Saudi Clashes
sections.body: The IDF destroyed a cross-border tunnel and seized weapons near Aitaroun in northern Galilee, while Lebanese observers recorded 106 drone detections and 18 artillery strikes across southern Lebanon including Aley Tarab and Mifdoun. Hezbollah claimed responsibility for missile and drone attacks on Saudi military positions in Mocha, Yemen, and a Houthi strike ignited a fire at an Aramco facility in Jazan with no casualties reported. Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei met President Pezeshkian to discuss economic management and military developments amid the ongoing U.S.-Israeli war, and Israeli forces rescued a construction worker who fell from approximately eight meters in Shoham.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The data shows escalating cross-border violence with IDF tunnel destruction and Hezbollah drone/artillery activity in Lebanon, alongside Iranian leadership deliberations on war strategy amid economic pressures. In Ukraine, Russian ballistic missile launches from Bryansk and massed Shahed drone waves across multiple regions indicate a coordinated saturation campaign, while expanded evacuations in Kherson signal sustained artillery pressure on civilians.
